integration: LSODA via scipy.integrate.solve_ivp, rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-13; periodic state from the affine one-cycle map; cycle averages integrated as states

PD.note_en: K065: blocking endogenous miR-7 and miR-153 raised an SNCA 3'UTR reporter by 44% in rat cortical neurons. For a repressor that holds a share rho of the mRNA's decay, removing it raises the level by 1 + rho, so rho = 0.44 for the pair. Reporter, not endogenous gene; two miRNAs lumped; the only loss-of-function observation in the table.
PD.note_pt: K065: bloquear miR-7 e miR-153 endogenos elevou em 44% um repórter da 3'UTR de SNCA em neuronios corticais de rato. Para um repressor que detem a parcela rho do decaimento do mRNA, retira-lo eleva o nivel por 1 + rho, entao rho = 0,44 para o par. Repórter, nao gene endogeno; dois miRNAs agrupados; a unica observacao de perda de funcao da tabela.

nucleation_scaling.note_en: Ratios of rates at two monomer levels depend on the reaction orders only, so they do not need the Abeta42 rate constants that no source gives (K037). In vitro orders applied to a brain monomer pool: a scaling, not a rate.
nucleation_scaling.note_pt: Razoes de taxas em dois niveis de monomero dependem so das ordens de reacao, entao nao precisam das constantes de velocidade do Abeta42 que nenhuma fonte da (K037). Ordens in vitro aplicadas a um pool cerebral de monomero: um escalonamento, nao uma taxa.

linear_limit.note: relative error of the knockdown at D = 1e-4

continuous_limit.note: knockdown at T = 0.05 h with the closed-form mean excess

brute_force_cycles.note: mean knockdown of cycle 120 from the untreated state, trapezoid on 4001 points

script12_constant_exposure.note: BACE1 protein ratio at the closed-form mimic factor against 1 - kappa

assumptions_en: The delivered mimic is cleared at the first-order rate of the endogenous species (K016-K021) and enters the repressor pool instantly. Repression is mass action: linear in the miRNA, saturating only through depletion of the mRNA. The delivered species acts like the endogenous pool, molecule for molecule. The three miR-29 paralogues start at equal levels and are pooled; miR-153 is lumped with miR-7. k_translate cancels, and k_repress enters through rho alone.
assumptions_pt: O mimetico entregue e eliminado na taxa de primeira ordem da especie endogena (K016-K021) e entra no pool do repressor instantaneamente. A repressao e acao de massas: linear no miRNA, saturando so pelo esgotamento do mRNA. A especie entregue age como o pool endogeno, molecula por molecula. Os tres paralogos de miR-29 comecam em niveis iguais e sao agrupados; o miR-153 e agrupado com o miR-7. O k_translate se cancela, e o k_repress entra so por rho.
